surface_mechanism_description: The surface roughness changed within the monolayer plateau area over the temperature range of 445 to 534±C. The lower range of temperatures, less than 475±C, is suitable for obtaining a smooth surface with roughness of less than one monolayer. The formation of anisotropic islands elongated along the T1N10U orientation was observed at growth temperatures over 475±C. The islands are formed from two-dimensional nucleation at the height of one monolayer in the temperature range from 475 to 534±C, and from three-dimensional nucleation at temperatures over 534±C. Anisotropic two-dimensional growth is due to the activity of adsorbed species on (111)A and (111)B steps. The decomposition reaction of MMG may be promoted on (111)B steps; otherwise, the desorption of AsHx on (111)A steps may occur.
